attributes.name: Blessing of Pharasma
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 1 die to any check.

When a character plays a spell on a check, discard this card to add 2 dice.

Discard this card to explore your location.

After you play this card, if it matches the top card of the blessings discard pile, recharge this card instead of discarding it.

corrections.corrected_text: On the blessing Blessing of Pharasma, in the second power, replace "to add 2 dice to a check when playing a spell" with "to add 2 dice to a check if a spell was played during that check." (Note: This card also appears in the Character Add-On Deck.)
corrections.issue: Earlier in the turn, I cast Strength on my character, and now I'm making a check. If I play Blessing of Pharasma, can I add 2 dice to the check?
